newsitem.title: SPAIN: ETA kidnap victim shot dead in Spain after threat.
newsitem.headline: ETA kidnap victim shot dead in Spain after threat.

text.p: A Spanish politician kidnapped by Basque ETA guerrillas has been shot in the head and killed, a judge said on Saturday.
Basque guerrillas ETA kidnapped Miguel Angel Blanco on Thursday and threatened to kill him at 4 p.m. (1400 GMT) on Saturday if the government did not change its prison policy.
Blanco had been found by highway rescue workers with his hands tied. He was rushed to hospital where officials confirmed he was dead.
The killing took place despite a rally of half a million Spaniards led by Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar in the northern Basque capital Bilbao to protest against the kidnap.
ETA has killed some 800 people since starting a drive for Basque independence in 1968.
The rebels have set deadlines to execute kidnap victims twice before, in 1981 and 1983, and in both cases the hostages were killed.
